name: @dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent
description: Rewrites the User-Agent sent by every outgoing HTTP request (LLM API calls and other global-fetch traffic) to a value of your choice, configured live from a dedicated UA 设置 (User-Agent) tab in the Web settings. 为 dsh 发出的所有出站 HTTP 请求（LLM API 调用等走全局 fetch 的流量）改写 User-Agent，并可在 Web 设置的 UA 设置 选项卡中实时配置。
stateReasons: ✗ stars 0 / forks 0(需 stars ≥20 或 forks ≥5)
